Cost notes:

* **tesseract**: No licence fee (Apache-2.0); cost = measured CPU time x assumed USD 0.05 per vCPU-hour of a general-purpose cloud VM (assumption, docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md).
* **azure**: Azure AI Document Intelligence, prebuilt-read, pay-as-you-go S0: USD 1.50 per 1000 pages (first 1M pages/month; list price, stan na 2026-10, do weryfikacji: https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/details/ai-document-intelligence/).
* **google**: Google Document AI, Enterprise Document OCR: USD 1.50 per 1000 pages (1-5M pages/month; list price, stan na 2026-10, do weryfikacji: https://cloud.google.com/document-ai/pricing).

A provider without credentials is reported as „uruchomienie pominięte”. Only synthetic pages are sent to cloud providers by this benchmark.
